summary: Pair with a computer to mirror a terminal session on e-ink.
release_notes: Adds a page description so the app directory listing reads properly in search results.

steps.text: Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Pair Paperterm. This trusts the computer and prints the address and code to enter on the reader.
Start a session and leave the terminal open.

page_description: Mirror a terminal session from your computer onto e-ink. The shell, credentials, and scrollback stay on the computer; the Kobo renders the session over a paired connection.
